name: Hanshagen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hanshagen (three green trees on yellow above a mill wheel on blue).
history: Arms and flag were approved together by the Ministry of the Interior on 29 November 1999 and registered as no. 201 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

features.role: Hanshagen arms — trees and mill wheel
